notes: Build an HTML sanitizer that must be correct against 4 hidden adversarial fragments (script/style/template/iframe removal, event-handler attributes, javascript:/data:/vbscript: URL schemes, allowlisted tags/attributes, comment stripping, case-insensitive tag matching, protocol-relative and relative URLs). The verifier executes the deliverable program on fresh inputs via a deterministic canonicalizer, so generalization is required, not just a visible-case output. Difficulty comes mostly from adversarial_inputs/hidden_case_generalization; the core algorithm is a standard HTMLParser pipeline, so it stays medium rather than hard.
